scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude crm-inkarma run typecheck
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude crm-inkarma run test
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings apps/hub apps/portal packages fixtures infra/scripts tests
scripts.build:hub: esbuild apps/hub/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=apps/hub/dist/main.mjs --external:pg-native --legal-comments=none --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
